bonds.analysis: We recommend a laddered bond portfolio with the following structure: we will hold 30% in one-year bonds, 20% in two-year bonds, 20% in three-year bonds, 15% in four-year bonds, and 15% in five-year bonds. This laddered structure ensures that no more than 30% of the portfolio matures in any single year, and distributes the risk over the 5-year horizon. The proposed allocation of 30% to 1-year bonds serves as a stable source of return, while the 20% allocation to 2-year, 3-year, and 5-year bonds provides flexibility and reduces concentration risk. As for the choice of specific bonds, we will recommend a mix of high-quality, investment-grade issuers with maturities matching the proposed allocation buckets.
